run_eval_sample_factory: run a stored SampleFactory agent over all scenario files in a validation set and save metrics
run_rollouts_single_episode: run a single rollout of a SampleFactory actor in the driving environment and collect goal and collision stats
eval_generalization_checkpoints: evaluate generalization for all agent checkpoints in a folder using multiprocessing across train and test sets
load_wandb_experiment: pull experiment results from the W&B server and save them as a CSV file for plotting
plot_goal_achieved_over_steps: plot number of training steps versus goal achieved percentage using W&B CSV data
